news.title: Updater Fixed
news.body: The in-Discord updater now correctly detects and applies updates. Auto update is now fully functional.

news.title: Welcome to RMS
news.body: Thanks for installing RMS! Join our Discord server to get support, report bugs, and stay up to date.

news.title: RMSTop v1.6.6 Released
news.body: RMSTop v1.6.6 is now available! This release includes the latest RMSTop build with bug fixes and improvements. Download RMSTop 1.6.6 setup.exe from the release page, run it, and once finished RMSTop is installed and ready for use!
